newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Santos stevedores begin strike.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Santos stevedores begin strike.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key port of Santos have gone on strike as of 0700 local/1000 GMT over a labor dispute, bringing operations at the port to a complete standstill, the director of the Stevedores Union said onWednesday.

"Today and tomorrow the strike will be on a regional level only in Santos, but on Friday the strike will spread to a national level if the impasse is not resolved," said Flavio Panez. "We don't think the impasse will be resolved by Friday."
Panez said the strike had brought the whole port to a stop.
He said Friday's strike would be a 24-hour stoppage, but could go on longer if there was still no progress in negotiations.
He said no fresh talks were scheduled so far.
